question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: Remember that intrnational travellers have to now get tested and quarantine after they land in the country.
Remember that international travellers have to now get tested and quarentine after they land in the country.
Remember that international travellers have to now get tested and quarantine after they land in the country.
Remember that international travellers have to now get tested and quarantine after they land in the contry.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Option 3 contains no spelling errors, whereas other options contain mistakes like "intrnational" instead of "international", "quarentine" instead of "quarantine", and "contry" instead of "country".**
 
• It is important to ensure that all words are correctly spelled to maintain the clarity and professionalism of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Remember that international travellers have to now get tested and quarantine after they land in the country."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** The word "intrnational" is misspelled. It should be "international".
 
• **Option 2:** The word "quarentine" is misspelled. It should be "quarantine".
 
• **Option 4:** The word "contry" is misspelled. It should be "country".
